text:
Jamie: Scheduling a coordinated rollout tonight 23:00 UTC — API v2.3, runtime 4.1.0, Console minor UI + schema tweak, Router routing weights update. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Any blockers?
Alex: Works for me. Do we need to pin model-serving or any runtime flags?
Dylan: Runtime needs a pin to 4.1.0-rc3 to avoid the kvcache behavior change. I'll cut a small canary first.
Priya: Console will land behind FF `console_v2_schema`. No toggles until API contract is confirmed.
Sam: Router change is just route-weight config (`router.weight.v2=0.5`). I'll hold the final toggle for 10m after runtime reports healthy.
Jamie: Add to release notes: API header change -> clients must send `X-Redwood-Model`. I'll paste a migration snippet later. Link: <https://redwood.internal/release/1841-api-v2.3-notes>
deploy-bot: Deployment kickoff scheduled by Jamie at 1841000800 (workflow: cross-service-staged).
Alex: If runtime shows regressions, rollback plan = runtime -> 4.0.8, then freeze API/router changes. Avoid half-upgrades.
Dylan: Agree. Rollback threshold: >=1% errors over 5m or sustained latency +30% -> rollback runtime. If we rollback runtime, hold router/console.
Priya: I'll keep the console rollback playbook open and have FF ready to flip off quickly.
deploy-bot: runtime canary started on pool-a (canary_id=canary-84). Command: `kubectl logs -f canary-84 -n runtime`
Sam: Canary metrics look stable at 2m, CPU and p50 within baseline. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary success. Proceeding with staged rollout: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m waits.
Jamie: Pause — CloudWatch trace shows a small spike of API header mismatches (~0.6% errors) after 50% runtime rollout. I'm going to pause at 50% and hold router changes.
Dylan: Pausing rollout. Router and console go into hold. Not yet rolling back runtime; investigating the header mismatch source.
Sam: Router rolled back to previous weights (`router.weight.v2=0.0`) per Jamie — confirmed propagation across regions.
Priya: Console release can go ahead since it's behind FF and independent of header. Enabling FF now for staging.
deploy-bot: console deployment completed (deploy_id=console-1841-2), smoke tests passed (10m).
Alex: We should update release notes ASAP with migration steps + SDK patch callouts so partners can adjust header behavior.
Jamie: I'll draft a short blurb and ping PMs + support. Reschedule router final toggle for 03:00 UTC to allow clients time to update.
Priya: SGTM, I'll coordinate with docs.
Dylan: Marking runtime rollout state = "paused - awaiting API versioning doc". I'll keep monitoring error budget and logs.
deploy-bot: runtime rollout status: PAUSED by Jamie at 1841001050.
Jamie: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene in #eng-releases at 02:30 UTC to decide next steps after SDKs are patched.
Sam: Noted. I'll keep an eye on routing metrics and stand by for 03:00 if we have the green.
Alex: Thanks — I'll start drafting the SDK hotfix and notify affected customers.
Priya: I'll update the console release notes to mention the pause and FF gating.
Dylan: If anything crosses 1% errors, we execute runtime rollback immediately and open incident.
Jamie: Cool. Thread agnostic to PMs for now. Closing out live ops, will reopen if conditions change.
